title: SPAKE password-scalar not multiplied by 8
description_snippet:
VULNERABILITY DETAILS

The M and N constants used by the BoringSSL SPAKE code (crypto/curve25519/spake25519.c) do not appear to be in the prime-order subgroup of the generator:

$ python -i ed25519.py 
>>> N = decodepoint('10e3df0ae37d8e7a99b5fe74b44672103dbddcbd06af680d71329a11693bc778'.decode
